text: News & Events Speakers Alexander Voyevoda Alexander Voyevoda UM Labs Organisation UM Labs LinkedIn Biography Alex Voyevoda is a senior systems engineer focused on turning high‑assurance ideas into production systems. With over 30 years of experience in low‑level C systems on Linux, he leads the implementation of Unicus Edge on Morello CHERI at UM Labs — bringing capability‑based memory safety and post‑quantum cryptography into real‑world streaming and IoT deployments. Alex holds a Ph.D. in Computer Aided Design from the National Technical University of Ukraine, combining academic research with long-term industrial systems development.
